remarks: Welcome to 27 Blue Ribbon Road - A serene retreat in the heart of Westport. Tucked away on a quiet, tree-lined street where neighbors still greet each other by name, this expanded split-level home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and community. With 4 spacious bedrooms, a dedicated home office, and a thoughtfully updated layout, this property is ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Step inside to discover updated kitchen, opening into an expanded family room with a vaulted ceiling. The home's classic shingle siding exudes timeless charm, while large windows fill the interior with natural light. Finished basement playroom area with bathroom and sliding doors to the pool. Outdoors, enjoy a private backyard oasis featuring an in-ground pool and fenced garden area for relaxing summer days or hosting friends and family. Whether you're walking the dog, chatting with neighbors at the bus stop, or heading out for a jog, this neighborhood offers a rare sense of connection and tranquility. Don't miss the opportunity to make this home your own.
